metadata.description: Registry of all bugs found during development. Each bug MUST have a corresponding regression test.

bugs.title: cardimage images permanently marked "Image unavailable" when off-screen at load (lazy-load race, never recovers)
bugs.description: John reported via screenshot: every card in demos/site/cards.html's Image Card section showed the "unavailable" fallback despite a valid, curl-verified-200 picsum.photos URL. cardimage() sets img.loading='lazy'; attachImageLoadRetry() started its readiness-check clock immediately regardless, so an off-screen image (true for any card deep in an eagerly-scanned generated page) raced a fetch the browser had not yet started. Confirmed live: zero network requests were ever made for the src before give-up. After ~27.5s (5 attempts) it hides the element and shows "unavailable" PERMANENTLY -- confirmed live that scrolling the failed card into view afterward does not recover it (no observer retries a settled element).
bugs.rootCause: The check/retry clock (scheduleCheck()) started unconditionally on attach, with no awareness that loading="lazy" means the browser may not attempt the fetch at all until near-viewport.
bugs.symptom: Every off-screen-at-load cardimage with loading=lazy showed a permanent, unrecoverable "⚠ Image unavailable" fallback regardless of URL validity.
bugs.whyNotCaughtBefore: tests/cards/cardimage-render.spec.ts only asserts an element exists with a non-empty src attribute -- it never checks naturalWidth/complete or whether the .wb-media-load-failed fallback fired. It validates markup structure, never actual load success, so a permanently-broken image with a valid-looking src passed every existing assertion.

fix.after: if (el.loading === 'lazy') { observe via one-shot IntersectionObserver (200px rootMargin), call scheduleCheck() only once actually intersecting } else { scheduleCheck() immediately as before }

testCases: cardimage: a valid, reachable src is not marked failed while off-screen past the old give-up window
cardimage: scrolling an off-screen image into view lets it load successfully (naturalWidth > 0)

bugs.title: x-youtube id="..." ignored, video never loads
bugs.description: John asked to verify <div x-youtube id="dQw4w9WgXcQ" ratio="16:9"> loads. It didn't: youtube() only ever read element.getAttribute('video-id'). Fourth attribute-name mismatch found in this session (after lightbox #374, alert #375, countdown #376): pages/components.html matches (video-id), but pages/behaviors.html and pages/newbehaviors.html both use plain id=, and the generator (scripts/generate-behaviors-page.js) emits data-id=. With config.id null, youtube() console.warn'd and returned before building any iframe or poster -- a permanently empty div.
bugs.rootCause: config.id only checked options.id / element.getAttribute('video-id') / a url= parse; never checked id or data-id.
bugs.symptom: x-youtube elements using id= (as authored on 2 of the 3 real pages, and in John's own test markup) rendered as an empty div with a console warning, no poster, no iframe.

fix.after: id: options.id || element.getAttribute('video-id') || element.getAttribute('id') || element.dataset.id || (url ? extractYouTubeId(url) : null)

testCases: YouTube: id="..." is read, no "No video ID provided" warning
YouTube: click-to-play poster renders and clicking it embeds the correct video id

bugs.title: x-countdown to="..." ignored, always shows stuck 00:00
bugs.description: Reported by John via screenshot: <div x-countdown to="2027-12-31"> showed a static 00:00 instead of counting down. Three-way attribute name mismatch: countdown() read only `date`, pages/behaviors.html used `to`, and its own generator (scripts/generate-behaviors-page.js) emitted a third name, `data-to`. None matched, so config.date was always '', and countdown() silently fell through to its unconditional 60s default -- which, having started long before anyone looked, always read 00:00.
bugs.rootCause: config.date only checked element.getAttribute('date'); never checked `to` (what the page actually uses) or `data-to` (what the generator emits).
bugs.symptom: Every x-countdown[to] demo displayed a stuck 00:00 instead of counting down to its target date.

fix.before: date: options.date || element.getAttribute('date') || '';  generator emitted data-to="2027-12-31"
fix.after: date: options.date || element.getAttribute('date') || element.getAttribute('to') || element.dataset.to || '';  generator now emits to="2027-12-31" (matches deployed page + the fixed fallback)

testCases: Countdown: to="..." target date is read (renders <days>d HH:MM:SS, not the 60s default)
Countdown: display actually ticks over time

bugs.title: x-alert variant styling never applied (warning/error render unstyled)
bugs.description: Reported by John via screenshot of the Behaviors showcase: warning and error alerts rendered with no background/border/color distinguishing them at all. alert() built the title/message/icon content and set a `variant` attribute, but never added any class to the element. src/styles/behaviors/alert.css styles alerts entirely through classes (.wb-alert base + .wb-alert--<variant> per-variant colors), so with no class present every alert rendered completely unstyled regardless of variant.
bugs.rootCause: alert() set element.setAttribute('variant', variant) but never called element.classList.add('wb-alert') or element.classList.add(`wb-alert--${variant}`).
bugs.symptom: All x-alert variants (info/success/warning/error) rendered identically -- no background color, no border, indistinguishable from plain unstyled divs.
testCases: Alert: warning and error variants get wb-alert + wb-alert--<variant> classes
Alert: warning and error variants have distinct, non-transparent backgrounds

bugs.title: x-lightbox buttons using data-src show no image on click (local dev only)
bugs.description: Two stacked bugs on pages/behaviors.html's Lightbox demo: (1) the local dev server (server.js) called the lazy-scanning WB.init() instead of matching production's eager scan, so x-* triggers below the fold never got their click handler attached in local dev; (2) once reachable, lightbox() never read element.dataset.src, so
bugs.rootCause: server.js: WB.init() with no eager scan (unlike scripts/generate-site.mjs's production output). overlay.js: lightbox()'s config.src fallback chain checked getAttribute('src')/element.src/element.href but never element.dataset.src.
bugs.symptom: Clicking a Lightbox demo button in local dev did nothing at all; after fixing the scan timing, it opened an overlay with a broken/blank image.

fix.before: server.js: WB.init();  |  overlay.js: src: options.src || element.getAttribute('src') || element.src || element.href || ''
fix.after: server.js: await WB.init({autoInject:true}); await WB.scan(document.body,{eager:true});  |  overlay.js: src: options.src || element.dataset.src || element.getAttribute('src') || element.src || element.href || ''

testCases: Lightbox: clicking a button[x-lightbox][data-src] shows the correct image, not a blank lightbox

bugs.title: Audio EQ panel missing controls
bugs.description: The Audio EQ panel was missing the Play/Pause button and Master Volume slider, which are required features.
bugs.rootCause: Controls row was missing from EQ panel construction logic
bugs.symptom: EQ panel showed sliders but no playback controls
testCases: Audio: EQ panel has Play/Pause button
Audio: EQ panel has Master Volume slider

bugs.title: Figure data-caption attribute ignored
bugs.description: The figure component was ignoring the data-caption attribute on the figure element, only looking for an existing figcaption element.
bugs.rootCause: Missing check for data-caption attribute in figure behavior
bugs.symptom: data-caption shows nothing on a figure element
testCases: Figure: renders caption from data-caption attribute

bugs.title: Audio src attribute set on div instead of dataset
bugs.description: The mkEl() function was setting el.src = v directly for all elements. For div containers (like audio, video containers), src should go to dataset.src since div elements don't have a native src property.
bugs.rootCause: Missing element type check before setting src attribute
bugs.symptom: Audio component showed no play/pause controls because the audio element was never created (src was lost)
testCases: Audio: src goes to dataset.src (not native src) for div container
Video (div container): src goes to dataset.src
Card Image: src goes to dataset.src for article container
REGRESSION: src goes to dataset NOT native attribute
